name: Boop never makes the wrong face
case: Over a mixed stretch of work (tests failing, then passing after failing, a long turn finishing well, then a new turn failing on an error), Boop's faces always fit what just happened. A failure never gets a happy, excited or proud face, or a cheer. A win never gets a grumpy or sad face.
why: harness/DECISIONS.md §3: each face's meaning (determined and grumpy for failures, sad only for a very long turn failing; happy, excited and proud for wins), and the cheer is never for a failure
